"""Generate large valid requests and time the submission."""
import json, random, subprocess, sys, time

def sliding(n_links=64, window=4, records=2000, big=False, seed=1):
    """Sliding window paths keep every interior link in the core."""
    rng = random.Random(seed)
    n = n_links + window
    rib = []
    i = 0
    while len(rib) < records:
        p = list(range(i+1, i+1+window))
        rib.append({'path': p, 'count': 1000000 if big else rng.randint(1,1000)})
        if len(rib) < records:
            rib.append({'path': list(reversed(p)), 'count': 1000000 if big else rng.randint(1,1000)})
        i += 1
    core = sorted((j, j+1) for j in range(2, n_links+1))
    return {'version': 1, 'ixps': [], 'rib': rib[:records], 'priors': [],
            'declared': [], 'order': [list(l) for l in core],
            'queries': [{'id': 'q%d' % i, 'path': [1,2,3], 'threshold': [1,2]}
                        for i in range(3)]}

def run(doc, label):
    raw = json.dumps(doc).encode()
    t = time.time()
    p = subprocess.run([sys.executable, '-I', '/workspace/submission/main.py'],
                       input=raw, stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.PIPE)
    dt = time.time()-t
    try:
        out = json.loads(p.stdout)
    except Exception:
        out = {'parse_error': p.stdout[:200]}
    print('%-22s bytes=%7d rc=%d time=%6.2fs links=%s %s' % (
        label, len(raw), p.returncode, dt,
        len(out.get('links', [])) if isinstance(out, dict) else '?',
        out.get('error', '')))
    if p.stderr:
        print('   stderr:', p.stderr[:300])
    return out

if __name__ == '__main__':
    run(sliding(64, 4, 2000), 'chain w4')
    run(sliding(64, 6, 2000), 'chain w6')
    run(sliding(64, 4, 2000, big=True), 'chain w4 big counts')
    run(sliding(64, 16, 2000), 'chain w16')
